title: Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making
title_zh: 输出纪律设定下限：一种以证伪为指导、模型无关的智能体协议，用于可审计的假设驱动决策

paragraphs.en: 在假设驱动决策任务中，模型输出纪律和推理结构比模型能力更为关键，新的智能体协议通过证伪过程提升了决策质量。 What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 在假设驱动决策任务中，模型输出的纪律性和推理结构比模型能力更为关键，新的智能体协议通过证伪过程提升了决策质量。是什么因素将大型语言模型约束在可审计的、假设驱动的决策任务中，其中每个候选方案都可以与证据进行核对？ 在针对中医辨证论治（TCMEval-SDT）的公开基准测试（200个案例）上，起约束作用的关键因素是输出纪律和推理结构，而非仅靠模型能力：两年来的模型规模扩展仅使零样本得分变化了-0.03至+0.08，而输出纪律问题（推理未终止、格式不合规、不同运行结果差异大）即使在前沿模型中依然存在。 我们通过一个模型无关的智能体框架对此进行了验证，该框架将决策过程形式化为一个五阶段闭环，并由候选方案与证据矩阵的证伪协议强制执行：每个候选方案都要与每一项证据进行比对，在得出结论之前必须至少有一半的候选方案被证伪，而通过验证的方案则以机器可验证的单行格式输出。 在五种基础模型中，该效果对零样本输出的纪律性具有符号依赖性：它能挽救那些纪律性不足的模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash：+0.267/+0.271，完全解决了终止问题），将高方差模型的运行间标准差从0.218降至0.007（Kimi K3），但对已有良好纪律性的模型则造成显著性能损失（预算匹配的Qwen3-4B/32B上得分从-0.087降至-0.120）。 消融实验表明，性能损失源于受候选方案限制的格式层，且该效果与注入的知识内容无关（协议与知识解耦）。 该协议也迁移到了抗虚假信息的能力更强的数学推理中，能以89.8%的召回率检测出被注入的虚假前提，同时假阳性率为6.8%（MCC 0.54；而“全部标记”基线模型得分为0），从而将准确性恢复至无虚假信息时的上限水平。 当零样本输出的纪律性较弱时，推理协议决定了性能的下限；而基础模型的能力则始终决定了性能的上限。
